framework.litellm:
# 安装内部版 litellm（先 pip uninstall -y litellm；对应分支/tag: main）：
# 1) HTTPS（本机已保存工蜂账号密码，或 CI/容器已配置 GIT_TOKEN）：
# pip install "aihub-litellm @ git+https://git.woa.com/aihub/litellm.git@main"
# 2) SSH（本机已在工蜂配置 SSH 公钥）：
# pip install "aihub-litellm @ git+ssh://git@git.woa.com/aihub/litellm.git@main"
from litellm import completion
import hashlib

API_KEY = "{{api_key}}"
PROVIDER = "minimax"
LITE_MODEL = "anthropic/minimax-m3.1-flash"
LITE_API_BASE = "http://api.aihub.woa.com/anthropic"

# 平台底层维护了多个上游账号，为了保证亲和性 cache_task_id 参数配置能保证 cache 缓存命中率, 具体参数解释 https://iwiki.woa.com/p/4051772719 务必替换成cache_task_id=<32位MD5>
CACHE_TASK_ID = hashlib.md5(f"task_demo:{API_KEY}".encode()).hexdigest()

response = completion(
    model=LITE_MODEL,
    max_tokens=4096,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "用一句话解释什么是分布式锁"}],
    api_base=LITE_API_BASE,
    api_key=f"{API_KEY}?provider={PROVIDER}&cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}",
    stream=False,
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)

endpoints.name: messages endpoint
endpoints.python:
import hashlib, json, requests

API_KEY = "{{api_key}}"
# 平台底层维护了多个上游账号，为了保证亲和性 cache_task_id 参数配置能保证 cache 缓存命中率, 具体参数解释 https://iwiki.woa.com/p/4051772719 务必替换成cache_task_id=<32位MD5>
CACHE_TASK_ID = hashlib.md5(f"task_demo:{API_KEY}".encode()).hexdigest()
PROVIDER = "minimax"
URL = "http://api.aihub.woa.com/anthropic/v1/messages"
HEADERS = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Authorization": (
        f"Bearer {API_KEY}?provider={PROVIDER}"
        f"&cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}"
    ),
}

body = {
    "model": "minimax-m3.1-flash",
    "max_tokens": 4096,
    "output_config": {"effort": "medium"},
    "system": "你是简洁的中文助手",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "用一句话解释什么是分布式锁"}],
    "stream": False,
    # "tools": [{"name": "get_weather",
    #            "description": "获取城市天气",
    #            "input_schema": {
    #                "type": "object",
    #                "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}},
    #                "required": ["city"]}}],
    # "tool_choice": {"type": "auto"},
    # 与上方 tools 不可同传
    # "tools": [{"type": "web_search_20250305", "name": "web_search"}],
}

# body["messages"] = [{"role": "user", "content": [
#     {"type": "image", "source": {
#         "type": "url",
#         "url": ("https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/"
#                 "file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241022/emyrja/"
#                 "dog_and_girl.jpeg")}},
#     {"type": "text", "text": "图里有几个人？只回答数字"}]}]
# body["messages"] = [{"role": "user", "content": [
#     {"type": "image", "source": {
#         "type": "base64", "media_type": "image/png",
#         "data": ("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAIAAACQd1PeAAAA"
#                  "DElEQVR4nGP4z8AAAAMBAQDJ/pLvAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC")}},
#     {"type": "text", "text": "这张图主色是什么？只回答一个词"}]}]
# body["messages"] = [{"role": "user", "content": [
#     {"type": "video", "source": {
#         "type": "url",
#         "url": ("https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/"
#                 "ee8c1648-21f1-41b7-8397-65022d22ffe5.mp4")}},
#     {"type": "text", "text": "用一句话描述视频内容"}]}]

r = requests.post(URL, headers=HEADERS, json=body, timeout=300,
                  stream=body["stream"])
r.encoding = "utf-8"

if body["stream"]:
    for line in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
        if not line.startswith("data:"):
            continue
        event = json.loads(line[5:])
        if event.get("type") == "content_block_delta":
            delta = event["delta"]
            print(delta.get("thinking") or delta.get("text") or "",
                  end="", flush=True)
    print()
else:
    print(json.dumps(r.json(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

cache_guidance.affinity_rule: 同一对话上下文复用同一个值，不同对话必须用不同值。该值只影响平台选号：相同值的请求会被路由到同一个上游账号。
cache_guidance.note: 两者需配合使用：cache_task_id 保证请求落到同一账号，prompt 缓存参数才可能在厂商侧命中；只设其一均无缓存收益。affinity_wire_format 为空表示平台尚未对外明确传参方式，请勿自行猜测。
